strings.zh: 啊~让你久等了！{SCROLL}欢迎来到口袋妖怪的世界！{SCROLL}我的名字是大木,{SCROLL}大家都叫我精灵博士。{SCROLL}话说回来,{NEWLINE}你是第一次参加冒险么？{SCROLL}首先,{NEWLINE}让我来为你介绍一下这个世界的事吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Sorry to keep you waiting!{SCROLL}Welcome to the world of Pokémon!{SCROLL}My name is Oak.{SCROLL}People call me the Pokémon Professor.{SCROLL}Now then, is this your first{NEWLINE}adventure?{SCROLL}First, let me tell you a little{NEWLINE}about this world!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 起源心金{NEWLINE}完结版4.0——特别版{NEWLINE}欢迎来到这个奇幻的世界{NEWLINE}一起回味最初的感动和快乐
strings.en: Pokémon Origin HeartGold{NEWLINE}Final Version 4.0: Special Edition{NEWLINE}Welcome to this world of wonders!{NEWLINE}Relive the first wonder and joy!

strings.zh: 关于起源心金{NEWLINE}操作方法的说明。
strings.en: How to play{NEWLINE}Pokémon Origin HeartGold.

strings.zh: 这就开始说明这个游戏的{NEWLINE}操作方法。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}在这个游戏中,{NEWLINE}点击被称为触摸屏{NEWLINE}的下方画面,{NEWLINE}就可以实现操作了哦！{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}请点击一下{NEWLINE}右下角的按钮。
strings.en: I’ll explain this game’s controls.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}You can control this game by{NEWLINE}touching the lower screen, also{NEWLINE}called the Touch Screen.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Please touch the panel in the{NEWLINE}bottom right of the Touch Screen.

strings.zh: 通过像这样点击画面,{NEWLINE}就可以进行确定和{NEWLINE}继续下一个对话了。
strings.en: By touching the screen like this,{NEWLINE}you can confirm selections and{NEWLINE}advance conversations.
strings.notes: Info-panel text (not the dialogue box): kept the zh line counts, no {SCROLL}.

strings.zh: 另外,写着「Ａ」的按钮,{NEWLINE}通过按Ａ键,{NEWLINE}也能达到同样的效果。
strings.en: You can also advance by pressing{NEWLINE}the A Button when you see the{NEWLINE}A Button icon on the Touch Screen.

strings.zh: 在触摸屏上,{NEWLINE}随着场景的不同,{NEWLINE}会显示出各种各样的按钮。
strings.en: Different touch buttons will appear{NEWLINE}on the Touch Screen depending on{NEWLINE}the situation.

strings.zh: 接下来,对于按键{NEWLINE}进行一下介绍。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}通过十字键,{NEWLINE}来实现进行主角的移动。
strings.en: Next, I’ll explain the button{NEWLINE}operations.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}You can move the main character{NEWLINE}using the +Control Pad.

strings.zh: 接下来,对于按键{NEWLINE}进行一下介绍。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}通过十字键,{NEWLINE}来实现进行主角的移动。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}在选择项目的时候,{NEWLINE}同样也要用到十字键。
strings.en: Next, I’ll explain about buttons.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Use the +Control Pad to move{NEWLINE}the main character.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}You can also use the +Control{NEWLINE}Pad to select entries.

strings.zh: 另外,在游戏的操作上{NEWLINE}除了点击触摸屏,{NEWLINE}用按键也是可以完成的。
strings.en: You can operate the screens using{NEWLINE}buttons instead of touching the{NEWLINE}Touch Screen.

strings.zh: 确定、调查、对话的时候使用。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}要返回、中止的时候,取消{NEWLINE}请使用这个按键。
strings.en: Used to confirm, check things{NEWLINE}and talk to people.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Use this to go back or cancel.

strings.zh: 想要打开菜单时,{NEWLINE}使用这个按键。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}钓竿、自行车等{NEWLINE}已经被登录的道具,{NEWLINE}通过按这个键可以使用。
strings.en: Press this button to{NEWLINE}open the menu.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Press it to use a registered{NEWLINE}item, such as a Fishing Rod{NEWLINE}or the Bicycle.

strings.zh: 到此为止的说明都明白了吗？
strings.en: Do you understand everything?

strings.zh: 我来依次说明一下{NEWLINE}游戏中经常会用到的{NEWLINE}各种不同的按键。
strings.en: Now I’ll go through the buttons{NEWLINE}you’ll use most often in{NEWLINE}the game, one by one.

strings.zh: 使用上下左右键,移动主人公。{NEWLINE}另外,在选择项目的时候,{NEWLINE}也同样是使用上下左右键。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}确定、调查、对话的时候使用。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}要返回、中止的时候,取消{NEWLINE}请使用这个按键。
strings.en: Use the +Control Pad to move{NEWLINE}the main character. It’s also{NEWLINE}used to choose options.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Used to confirm, check things{NEWLINE}and talk to people.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Use this to go back or cancel.

strings.zh: 打开菜单。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}钓竿、自行车等{NEWLINE}已经被登录的道具,{NEWLINE}通过按这个键可以使用。
strings.en: Opens the menu.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Press it to use a registered{NEWLINE}item, such as a Fishing Rod{NEWLINE}or the Bicycle.

strings.zh: 下方的画面{NEWLINE}叫做“触摸屏”。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}在触摸屏上,{NEWLINE}根据情况的不同,{NEWLINE}会显示出各种各样的按钮。
strings.en: The lower screen is called{NEWLINE}the “Touch Screen.”{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Different buttons appear on{NEWLINE}the Touch Screen depending{NEWLINE}on the situation.

strings.zh: 下方画面上,显示出{NEWLINE}很多按钮的时候,{NEWLINE}会出现这个记号。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}那时候,请点击下方画面的按钮{NEWLINE}进行选择。
strings.en: If this mark is shown in the{NEWLINE}message window, there are active{NEWLINE}buttons you can touch on the{NEWLINE}Touch Screen below.

strings.zh: 接下来,为你说明{NEWLINE}按钮的操作方法。
strings.en: Next, I’ll explain how{NEWLINE}to use the buttons.

strings.zh: 到此为止的说明{NEWLINE}都明白了吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Do you understand everything{NEWLINE}so far? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 画面下方触摸屏里的按钮,{NEWLINE}请按一下。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Please touch a button on the{NEWLINE}Touch Screen below. {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 从现在开始的世界中,{NEWLINE}你将作为主人公,{NEWLINE}开始冒险的旅程！
strings.en: You are about to enter a world{NEWLINE}where you will embark on a grand{NEWLINE}adventure of your very own.

strings.zh: 在屋子里、道路上、草丛里,{NEWLINE}还有洞窟内和森林之中⋯⋯{NEWLINE}请和各个不同地方的人们{NEWLINE}搭话试试看。
strings.en: In houses, on roads, in the grass,{NEWLINE}in caves and in forests...{NEWLINE}Try talking to the people{NEWLINE}you meet in all these places.
strings.notes: US 0219/29 | RV058: addition: 'Everyone has something to say' not in zh

strings.zh: 帮助有难处的人们,{NEWLINE}通过解开谜题,{NEWLINE}进而开启新的道路。
strings.en: Help people in need and{NEWLINE}solve puzzles, and new paths{NEWLINE}will open up to you.
strings.notes: US 0219/30 | RV058: addition: 'overcome challenges' not in zh

strings.zh: 有时,人们{NEWLINE}会邀请你进行对战,{NEWLINE}被野生的生物们{NEWLINE}挡住去路的事情也是有的吧？{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}通过战胜对手,{NEWLINE}你会逐渐变强。
strings.en: At times, people will challenge{NEWLINE}you to battle.{NEWLINE}And wild creatures may block{NEWLINE}your path, too.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}By defeating your opponents,{NEWLINE}you will gradually grow stronger.
strings.notes: US 0219/31 | RV058: meaning: zh = grow stronger gradually by defeating foes, not 'gain great power'

strings.zh: 但是,变强并不是{NEWLINE}此次冒险的唯一目的。
strings.en: However, your adventure is not{NEWLINE}solely about becoming powerful.

strings.zh: 在旅行的途中,{NEWLINE}与许许多多的人相互接触,{NEWLINE}使自己得到成长。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}这才是此次冒险{NEWLINE}最主要的目的所在。
strings.en: On your travels, you will meet{NEWLINE}countless people and grow{NEWLINE}through them.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}That is the most important{NEWLINE}goal of this adventure.

strings.zh: 在这个世界上,{NEWLINE}到处生活着口袋妖怪{CLEAR}又名：精灵{CLEAR}这是一种不可思议的生物！{SCROLL}
strings.en: This world is widely inhabited by{NEWLINE}creatures known as Pokémon.{CLEAR}They are truly mysterious beings!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0219/34 | RV058: omission: 不可思议的生物 (D-1728)

strings.zh: 我们人类{NEWLINE}和精灵友好融洽地生活在一起。{SCROLL}一起玩耍,协力工作,{SCROLL}在与精灵同伴合作的对战中,{NEWLINE}建立起深刻的羁绊⋯⋯{SCROLL}而我为了更详细地了解精灵们的情况,{SCROLL}每天都在进行这样的研究哦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: We humans live alongside Pokémon{NEWLINE}as friends.{SCROLL}We play together, and we work{NEWLINE}together.{SCROLL}When we battle alongside Pokémon,{NEWLINE}we form deep bonds with them...{SCROLL}And to learn more about Pokémon...{SCROLL}I study them every single day!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那么,快点{NEWLINE}告诉我一些你的事吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Now, why don’t you tell me a little bit{NEWLINE}about yourself?{SCROLL}
